sceneProps.wave_review_method: Bounded least-squares bending-energy smoothing of the 3-D tip grid; height weight .12, lateral weights .024; axial second differences plus .35-weight diagonals. Caps: +/-5 mm height, +/-2 mm each lateral axis.
sceneProps.wave_review_note: Existing cutting templates do not match these adjusted shapes; regenerate only after choosing the design.
sceneProps.inner_alignment: Scale all vertices about midpoint of base hypotenuse. The inner hypotenuse lies on the outer hypotenuse with coincident midpoints.
sceneProps.presentation_only: Materials and paper-thickness/bevel modifiers do not change the underlying refined outer geometry. Existing cutting files are not updated.
sceneProps.xy_review_method: Bounded least-squares smoothing of tip offsets along rows, columns, and weighted diagonals. X/Y weight 0.12, total movement limited to +/-5 mm per axis from the manual original. Preserve current Z and bases exactly.
